newsitem.title: CHINA: CNPC units to issue 1.34 billion yuan bonds.
newsitem.headline: CNPC units to issue 1.34 billion yuan bonds.

text.p: Seven units of China National Petrochemical Corp have received approval to issue a total of 1.34 billion yuan in corporate bonds in early December, the China Securities newspaper said on Saturday.
The parent company will provide a guarantee for the bonds, which have a three-year term and annual interest of 10.5 percent, to be paid once on maturity, it said.

The seven units of the company are in Maoming, Liaoyang, Tianjin, Jinling in Nanjing city, Daqing, Jiujiang city in Hubei province and Urumqi and the money will be used for major petrochemical projects, it said but gave no more details.
